description: This file contains an interrupt service routine (ISR) handler for the AT91 MCI (Memory Card Interface) controller, implemented in ARM assembly. It handles saving and restoring context during interrupt processing, interacting with the Advanced Interrupt Controller (AIC) and switching CPU modes as necessary.

methods.name: AT91F_ASM_MCI_Handler
methods.description: Assembly interrupt handler for the AT91 MCI; manages context saving/restoring and invokes the MCI handler.
